text_parts: Compare the two supplied images. Is there a visibly supported physical state change of any object between Frame A and Frame B? Return JSON with decision MATCH, NO_MATCH, or UNCERTAIN; supporting_frames as A/B identifiers; evidence as a concise visible explanation. MATCH requires an actual visibly changed object. Identical images are NO_MATCH. If the evidence is insufficient choose UNCERTAIN. Do not infer an action from object presence or movement unless the images support it.
